ANNOUNCEMENT BY HON. GOVERNOR, CENTRAL PROVINCE

Delegation of power under the Co-operative Societies Statute No. 10 of 1990of the Central Provincial Council as amended by the Co-operative Societies (Amendment)Statute No. 4 of 1993 of the Central Provincial Council in accordance with theConstitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

I, S. B. S. Abayakoon, as the Governor of the Central Provincial Council, in accordance with the powers vested in me by the Article 154(c) of the Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka, in terms of Sub-sections 2(2), 2(4) of Co-operative Societies Statute No. 10 of 1990 of the Central Provincial Council as amended by the Co-operative Societies (Amendment) Statute No. 04 of 1993 of the Central Provincial Council, I hereby declare that powers referred in Column III will be delegated to the Deputy Commissioner of Co-operative Development (Sri Lanka Administrative Service) of the Central Provincial Council referred to in Column No. 1 below with eﬀ ect from the date speciﬁ ed in Column II.
